title: Biden marijuana pardon
body: Pardoned simple possession of marijuana under federal law. No names are listed and DOJ has no count.

title: Biden marijuana pardon, expanded
body: Extended the pardon to attempted possession and use of marijuana. No names are listed and DOJ has no count.

title: January 6 proclamation
body: Pardoned people convicted of offenses related to January 6, 2021 and commuted 14 sentences. About 1,500 is a reported figure; there is no official count.

title: 2020 election proclamation
body: Pardoned 77 named people for offenses related to the 2020 presidential election.
